entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S.Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.6716 of 2019
Order:

The Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.320 of 2018 on the file of II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore.

entities.text: II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
3.
The offences involved in this case under Sections 353, 272 and 273 of Indian Penal Code does not fall under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner points out that the second accused has approached this Court through C.C.No.6139 of 2019 and the learned single Judge considering the order passed in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018, quash the proceedings.

5. This Court is of the opinion that the matter is squarely covered by the earlier judgment of this Court including the two judgments which are filed as material papers and hence, all the further proceedings are quashed in C.C.No.320 of 2018 on the file of II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore.

entities.text: II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
SPR THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU CRIMINAL PETITION No.6716 of 2019 Dated 19.12.2019.
